#######################################
1. Setting up the script
#######################################


Set up filepath, notation and packages
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 100, digits = 4)

#Set filepath
setwd("/Users/langgao/Downloads/Freelancer projects/Sonder/Indonesia/Segmentation")
```

Load packages
```{r,echo=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
pacman::p_load("foreign","tidyverse","readxl","ggplot2","ggalluvial","ggrepel","gridExtra","cowplot","survey","dplyr","scales","RColorBrewer","networkD3","haven","corrplot","forcats","vtable","srvyr","readr","vtable","data.table","kableExtra")
```

##############################################
2. Data Preparation
##############################################
Read in original data
```{r}
dhs.seg <- readRDS("5_Indonesia_DHS_exploratory.rds")

#dim(dhs.seg) #49627   311

#dhs.seg$v201
#summary(dhs.seg$v201)
#table(dhs.seg$v201)

dhs.seg.wmchild <- dhs.seg %>% 
  filter(v201 > 0)

#dim(dhs.seg.wmchild) #34199   311

saveRDS(dhs.seg.wmchild, file = "Indonesia_DHS_wmchild.rds")
```
